content: Homelessness and housing insecurity create significant challenges for effective diabetes management. Individuals experiencing these conditions often lack access to safe storage for insulin and other essential diabetes supplies, which can compromise their ability to maintain proper treatment regimens. Additionally, this population frequently encounters food insecurity, which can make it difficult to adhere to recommended dietary guidelines for diabetes care. They also tend to have lower levels of health literacy, which may hinder their understanding of diabetes management strategies. Furthermore, there is a higher prevalence of cognitive and behavioral health issues among this group, which can further complicate their ability to manage their condition effectively.
